scope.evidence: Server-resolved canonical country facts only; client prose and fact claims are excluded.
scope.sources: Completed replies receive a deterministic source footer to the country profile and selected source labels.
scope.privacy: No application-database transcript; browser-local history and content-free operational metadata only.
scope.failure: Missing key, context failure, and provider failure return a fixed unavailable response without fallback.

automatedChecks: server evidence is bounded and source-labelled
prompt injection remains JSON user data and cannot alter the static system prompt
unavailable and disputed values never become observed facts
audit records include only contract/prompt/model/outcome/count metadata
request schema rejects client-supplied country facts and arbitrary tabs

providerReferences.purpose: Provider API data-retention disclosure boundary; zero-data-retention is not assumed.
Prompt-injection mitigation boundary: static instructions, untrusted JSON data, least privilege, and adversarial tests.

ownerFollowUp: Confirm the actual Anthropic organization/workspace retention arrangement before any zero-data-retention claim; retain no credential, account identifier, or console screenshot.
